column1: # SJL-13.1 task 1.1, the probe plan: one line per probe and engine to run, then one line
# per row answered by a cited baseline (engine "cited": listed, not re-run). Generated
# from the probe tables of the five readings (rows-T, rows-N, rows-P, rows-D and rows-R) and from
# the seven probe manifests. Expected answers are the code's, as each reading wrote them; the run compares.
# $VM_SC, $VM_CF, $VM_CLI = the Release DLLs of Broiler.VM's SliceCompiler, Conformance and Cli roots in
# $VMW (4cf9ca4); $JS_PC = the SJL-12 parse-corpus tool's and $JS_SH = the shell BroilerJS's Release
# DLLs in $JSW (d6795fc8). Every command runs under TZ=UTC with LANG, LANGUAGE, LC_* and BROILER_*
# unset. A parse probe's command is its manifest's one run; its answer is that id's rows of the run's report. A value
# line's answer is the line its label begins; T's value lines are named TV-<line> so that no answer file name differs
# from a parse probe's (T06A and T06a) only in case. "S" is THROWS SyntaxError: <message>; messages are not predicted.
# rows-P-baseline.tsv.gz and rows-P-agree.tsv.gz are the P reading's classified joins of VB and JB (analysis/).
